note: One-shot production builds with the Vite and webpack plugins (Next.js without Turbopack included) drop the component-selector markers no module selects. Each transform and the start-of-build scan report the markers they give and select; once every module is compiled, a marker no module selects or writes leaves the output chunks. When a module selects a component but the scan never read it (virtual module, a file compiled by another tool such as MDX, require.context / import.meta.glob / computed import(), or a file outside the scanned roots and entries), the build keeps every marker and warns with the module and the reason. The scan now also follows require.context and import.meta.glob calls whose arguments are written out. Warm webpack builds read the reports of modules restored from the persistent cache. Dev servers, watch builds, Turbopack and the Rsbuild and Bun plugins keep every marker.
